defect: The fix only reflows the RowNumberColumnReader::Stats signature onto one line after a std::vector to vector rename; behaviour is unchanged.
reason: Pure formatting fix; the per-row-group statistics logic added by the change is untouched and correct.

defect: The fix makes is_vector match duckdb::vector instead of std::vector.
reason: At the change duckdb::vector was a using-alias of std::vector, so the trait was correct; it broke only when the later safe duckdb::vector class was merged.

defect: The fix qualifies vector as duckdb::vector in a test that also has using namespace std.
reason: The ambiguity exists only after duckdb::vector became a distinct class; at the change both names denoted std::vector.

defect: The fix switches the Node binding from std::unique_ptr and std::vector to duckdb::unique_ptr and duckdb::vector.
reason: At the change duckdb's vector and unique_ptr were aliases of the std types; the fix adapts to the later safe container types.

defect: The fix adds a write_partition_columns parameter to ToCSV.
reason: Feature addition; the change was only a format fix of the declaration.

defect: PushdownWindow pushes a filter below the window as soon as it is on the partition of any one window expression, although it must be on the partition of every window expression, giving wrong results with differently partitioned window functions.
reason: The fix (caught by TPC-DS q47) replaces exactly this per-expression push loop, added by this change, with an all-expressions check.

defect: The change removes AppendBoolean and declares the primary Append<T> template without a definition or a bool specialization, so Append<bool> as used by the R package fails to link.
reason: The fix gives the primary template a body (and drops the duplicate double declaration) in exactly these added lines to resolve the R link failure.

defect: The fix reverts Append<int> back to Append<int32_t> in the R appender.
reason: int and int32_t are the same type on supported platforms, so the change and its revert are cosmetic; the real link problem lay in the appender header.

defect: The fix removes the 'Unaligned fetch' InternalException check in StandardColumnData::Update.
reason: The check was added earlier in 7c9decc (2025-07-22); this change only passed explicit scan states and did not alter the compared counts.

defect: The rewritten GetChunkInternal advances lhs_idx before the RHS matches of the current key are exhausted (and again via the for loop) and does not reset rhs_chunk for a new LHS chunk, so matches pair with the wrong LHS row or are lost.
reason: The same-day fix reworks precisely this new lhs_idx and rhs_chunk iteration logic.

defect: The fix replaces Storage::BLOCK_SIZE with BLOCK_ALLOC_SIZE when walking payload blocks in Combine and Scan.
reason: At the change payload blocks were allocated with BLOCK_SIZE, so Merge was consistent; the mismatch came from a later switch to buffer-managed BLOCK_ALLOC_SIZE blocks.

defect: The fix renames the placeholder MyTask and moves final_ht->Finalize() into the scheduled task.
reason: Continuation of the parallel-finalize feature; the placeholder task worked and nothing it did is repaired.

defect: total_cardinality and cur_rows_read are declared uninitialized and compared after the loop, which is undefined behaviour and a spurious failure when the loop body never runs.
reason: The fix initializes exactly these two variables added by this change (the test had been disabled meanwhile).

defect: RegisterExceptions imports the Python 2 'exceptions' module and its StandardError, which do not exist in Python 3, so module initialization fails.
reason: The fix removes exactly that import and base class from lines this change added.

defect: In the sort-key FIRST/LAST Update, is_null is read with validity.RowIsValid(assign_sel[i]) without mapping through idata.sel, so NULLs are misdetected for dictionary or sliced input.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this is_null computation introduced by this change.

defect: The default-value copy fills a selection with default_idx, already resolved through the default vector's own selection, and passes it to VectorOperations::Copy on the unflattened vector, applying the selection twice.
reason: The fix sets the selection entries to row_idx in exactly these new lines; the old code had flattened the default vector first.

defect: The fix joins the duckdb_append_default_to_chunk declaration onto one line.
reason: Formatting only.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(flag_bytes != 0) fails for a group with a single value, whose first value carries no flag, so debug builds abort.
reason: The fix removes exactly this assertion as wrongful; seeing that a group can have zero flag bytes needs the Chimp flag-buffer semantics.

defect: The fix removes a no-op D_ASSERT(1) from the constructor.
reason: D_ASSERT(1) never fires; its removal is cleanup.

defect: The fix renames the UPSERT test and adds a type-inference test.
reason: Test additions only.

defect: The fix extends the UPSERT test to also run with ANY (inferred) types.
reason: Test extension for a new feature; the added test had no defect.

defect: Next() passes collection.segments[current_segment_idx] to FinalizePinState after NextScanIndex has already advanced current_segment_idx, so pins are released or stored against the wrong segment when the end lies at the start of the next segment.
reason: The fix uses the segment index saved before NextScanIndex in exactly this call introduced by the change.

defect: The fix changes a loop variable from int32_t to index_t.
reason: n was int at the change; the signed/unsigned mismatch appeared only after n became index_t later.

defect: The new parallel-append test expects COUNT(*) to equal i+1 in each thread although other threads' committed inserts are visible, so it fails spuriously.
reason: The fix (race condition in parallel index test) replaces exactly this expected count, added by this change, with initial count plus i+1.

defect: The fix replaces 'return std::move(root);' with 'return root;' in TransformMaterializedCTE.
reason: A redundant std::move on a by-value parameter only triggers a warning; behaviour is identical.

defect: The fix makes the caller split deleted row ids per row group and changes RowGroup::Delete to take a row_t array.
reason: The assumption that one delete batch lies in a single row group was in DataTable::Delete before this change; the added assertions only exposed it.

defect: The fix adds braces and makes the buffer-size constant int64_t for clang-tidy.
reason: Tidy and style fix only.

defect: The new EnumTypeInfoTemplated constructor checks validity.RowIsValid(i) instead of RowIsValid(idx), testing the wrong row for non-flat vectors.
reason: The fix changes exactly this line added by the change.

defect: The fix silences unused-variable warnings and adds assertions to the new test.
reason: Warning cleanup and test strengthening; no functional defect.

defect: The new conditions 'column > 0 || try_add_line' at a newline and in final_state never add a row for a single-column CSV, where column is always 0, so its rows are merged or dropped.
reason: The fix for #5566 (single-column CSV) extends exactly these two conditions introduced by this change.

defect: The fix removes the unused UpdateSegment *updates member from ColumnAppendState.
reason: Dead-member cleanup.

defect: max_row = MinValue(count, parent.max_row - start) underflows when the row group starts beyond parent.max_row, so the row group is scanned fully instead of not at all.
reason: The fix guards exactly these two lines added by this change.

defect: The fix PROTECTs the SEXPs held by RArrowTabularStreamFactory.
reason: The factory already held unprotected SEXPs before this change, which only renamed the member.

defect: The refactor checks the sniffer's own error_handler for MAXIMUM_LINE_SIZE instead of best_candidate->error_handler, so the maximum line size error is never raised.
reason: The old loop iterated best_candidate's errors; the fix restores best_candidate in exactly the new line.

defect: The fix adapts RoundTrip to the new ToArrowSchema(schema, array) API and drops the H2O dictionary test.
reason: Test maintenance after a later API change and a data-file update.

defect: The R data frame scan is made parallel, so R API functions (VECTOR_ELT, INTEGER_POINTER, STRING_ELT, CHAR) run on DuckDB worker threads, which R does not support.
reason: The next-day fix reverts exactly this parallel global/local-state scan to the single-threaded scan.

defect: The fix moves expr.lhs and expr.expr into the JSON arrow expression instead of copying them, so bound children survive in correlated subqueries.
reason: The copy-based JSON arrow block existed before this change, which only moved it.

defect: BindCopyOptions binds every option expression, so a bare * option such as FORCE_QUOTE *, previously the string '*', now fails to bind.
reason: The fix adds a compatibility path turning a raw * into '*' in exactly this new binding code.

defect: The fix puts catch.hpp before ../tpch/test_helpers.hpp.
reason: The change kept catch.hpp first; the wrong include order came from the intermediate format commit 5837a3e.

defect: The refactor locks context_lock manually in Connection::OpenAppender and unlocks it only in CloseAppender, so an exception in the Appender constructor leaves the connection lock held.
reason: The fix moves the lock into a unique_lock owned by the Appender (this header and connection.cpp), repairing the leak flagged by the TODO this commit added.
